steps.text: scanner-glow-bounds (Saleh's playtest of 2026-11-07, item 11): the sweep light stays inside the painted scanner's glass in the top view. Day 12 with every item (the scanner owned, no tutorial). The passport goes from the counter onto the desk (the hand-over enters the top view), then onto the scanner by screen fraction; the scan (0.8 s) is recorded as the frame sequence scan_top; stills of the top view at rest and after the scan. Measure with PIL: the bar's bounding box against the glass rect. The office view's scan is a separate task (scanner-glow-office).
